en: The postcard shows three historical black-and-white photographs: a veranda in front of a dining hall labeled 'Veranda vor dem Speisesaal', an old house identified as the residence of Frederick the Great in the years 1744 and 1746 labeled 'Das alte Haus. Wohnung Friedrichs des Grossen i.J. 1744 u. 1746.', and a villa labeled 'Neue Villa'. The card is elaborately decorated with floral motifs. At the top right, the printed name 'Pyrmont, Richter's Pension.' is visible, followed by handwritten script. The reverse is a standard postcard layout with an old German postage stamp and cancellation marks. The address side shows a stamp from the 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont', and is addressed to Carl Karninke in Ronsdorf.
